prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-29466
prose.body:
Hi Driftmoor Retail team,

Hope you’re having a great week! This is a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-29466 for $8,961.73 USDC.

As part of our routine, we’d like to ensure this payment is processed so we can keep your catering services running smoothly. As per our standard billing procedures, please direct the transfer to our usual vendor wallet: 0x1d68dcd70c5c33a5e5f8bfb61831ed93af581b13.

If you’ve already sent the funds, please feel free to disregard this message. Otherwise, a quick transfer would be greatly appreciated. Let us know if you need a copy of the invoice or have any questions.

Thanks so much!

Warm regards,
Valebrook Catering
